components.description: Structural cornerstone featuring deep-skirt crankcase, 7 cross-bolted main saddles, and 12 Nikasil-plated 88mm bores.
components.engineeringNotes: Handles up to 1,200 HP and 10,500 RPM with CGI matrix structural integrity.

components.description: Fully counter-weighted 6-throw crankshaft with gun-drilled main journals and 60° even-fire journal spacing.
components.engineeringNotes: Dynamic balance rating under 0.25 g-mm with micro-polished journals.

components.description: Lightweight slipper-skirt piston with diamond-turned ring lands, gas accumulator grooves, and DLC-coated wrist pin.
components.engineeringNotes: Compression ratio: 12.8:1 (NA) / 9.5:1 (Turbo). Withstands 140 bar peak cylinder pressure.

components.description: 140mm center-to-center H-beam connecting rod featuring rifle-drilled forced pin oiling and balanced within 0.5g.
components.engineeringNotes: Rated for 11,000 RPM reciprocating loads with zero fatigue propagation.

components.description: DOHC crossflow cylinder head housing 12 intake (36mm) and 12 exhaust (31mm) sodium-filled titanium valves.
components.engineeringNotes: Combustion chamber volume: 38.5 cc. CNC 5-axis ported runner flow rate: 365 CFM @ 28 in H2O.

components.description: Bank 2 DOHC cylinder head mirror-paired with Bank 1, staggered +15mm along crankshaft axis.
components.engineeringNotes: Combustion chamber volume: 38.5 cc. CNC 5-axis ported runner flow rate: 365 CFM @ 28 in H2O.

components.description: CNC machined billet valve cover with internal oil baffle labyrinth and integrated spark plug O-ring sealing wells.
components.engineeringNotes: High-temperature viton perimeter seal with zero leakage up to 2.5 bar crankcase pressure.

components.description: Bank 2 matching billet valve cover with oil filler neck and crankcase breather AN-10 fitting.
components.engineeringNotes: High-temperature viton perimeter seal with zero leakage up to 2.5 bar crankcase pressure.

components.description: 6 S-curved individual throttle body intake runners with parabolic ceramic thermal barrier coating.
components.engineeringNotes: Equal-length 280mm runner geometry tuned for 7,800 RPM Helmholtz resonance wave boost.

components.description: Bank 2 matching ITB intake runners feeding cylinders 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12.
components.engineeringNotes: Equal-length 280mm runner geometry tuned for 7,800 RPM Helmholtz resonance wave boost.

components.description: 6-into-1 equal-length hydroformed Inconel 625 primary pipes (42mm) merging into a 76mm pyramidal collector.
components.engineeringNotes: Withstands continuous exhaust gas temperatures up to 1,050°C with zero thermal distortion.

components.description: Bank 2 hydroformed exhaust header terminating in a machined V-band flange for turbocharger coupling.
components.engineeringNotes: Withstands continuous exhaust gas temperatures up to 1,050°C with zero thermal distortion.

components.description: Aerospace-grade twin-scroll turbocharger with 76mm billet compressor wheel and dual ceramic ball bearings.
components.engineeringNotes: Max spool RPM: 145,000. Capable of delivering 2.4 bar boost with 78% adiabatic compressor efficiency.

components.description: Low-profile billet scavenge trough with 4 AN-12 scavenge ports, centrifugal de-aerator tank, and spin-on racing filter.
components.engineeringNotes: Eliminates oil starvation up to 3.5 G lateral cornering loads. Lowers engine center of gravity by 65mm.

components.description: Dual-pass micro-louvered cooling core with carbon fiber fan shroud, 7 aerodynamic blades, and reinforced silicone hoses.
components.engineeringNotes: Dissipates up to 180 kW thermal energy with 85 L/min coolant flow rate at full load.

components.description: Rear-mounted 7-speed longitudinal sequential transaxle with integrated Salisbury limited-slip differential and CV axle outputs.
components.engineeringNotes: Straight-cut dog rings enable 25ms clutchless paddle-shifts under full throttle torque.

components.description: Pre-preg carbon fiber shroud with scratch-resistant quartz glass ITB window, ram-air scoop, and CNC gold perimeter bezel.
components.engineeringNotes: Aerodynamic ducting channels 450 CFM ambient airflow directly over the central valley fuel rails.

components.description: Dual-roller heavy-duty timing chain linking the crankshaft snout to 4 adjustable vernier camshaft sprockets.
components.engineeringNotes: Includes hydraulic tensioners and PTFE chain guide dampening pads.
